comment: The knob-and-CV totals are shaped before use rather than read straight: temper is squared and scaled to a maximum of 0.15, resonance is raised to the power of a tenth, noise and impulse are squared, and overdrive maps to a factor of two to twenty-two (Alloy.cpp:440).
